The Fe 50Mn30Co10Cr10 powders with particle sizes 45–105 lm were produced by gas atomization of Fe, Mn, Co and Cr (99.99% purity) in Ar atmosphere.

the LMD process parameters are selected as follows: laser power was 500 W, laser beam diameter was 1.2 mm and scanning speed was 200 mm/min. The samples were deposited using the single-track and multi-layer strategy. The height of the laser head rose by 0.5 mm after each single-track scan.
the area fraction of the FCC c phase of the as-deposited sample is about 88.7%, and the rest is HCP e phase, about 11.3%.
